questions.q: According to the overview, myths help people understand which type of truths?
questions.why: Myths aid in grasping elusive truths about existence.

questions.q: What function do myths serve in forming group identity?
a: Explain origins of life or culture
questions.why: Myths explain beginnings, shaping a distinct group identity.

questions.q: What common theme appears in marriage myths across cultures?
questions.why: Marriage myths often describe partners as completing each other's spirit.

questions.q: How do myths assist individuals facing death, as described in the text?
a: They comfort fear and give meaning
questions.why: Myths help comfort fears and make sense of mortality.

questions.q: In Indonesian tribal belief, what act was required before a young man could marry?
questions.why: The tribe believed a kill was needed for a new generation to emerge.
